listening.title: A call about moving to a bigger plan

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: Hi Hoa, thanks for the call. I looked at your account growth this quarter.

lines.speaker: Hoa (IT manager, client)
lines.text: Yes, we added twenty new users, so the system feels a bit slow sometimes.

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: That matches the data. You are close to the usage limit of your current plan.

lines.speaker: Hoa (IT manager, client)
lines.text: What happens if we go over it? Do you stop the service?

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: No, but reports get slower. Many clients your size trade up to the business plan.

lines.speaker: Hoa (IT manager, client)
lines.text: How much more would that cost us every month?

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: About fifteen percent more, and it includes the extra module you asked about.

lines.speaker: Hoa (IT manager, client)
lines.text: Interesting. Is there a package deal if we take training as well?

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: Yes. With a package deal the average order value is higher, so I can give a better rate.

lines.speaker: Hoa (IT manager, client)
lines.text: Send me the numbers. If it helps us make the most of the tool, I will ask my boss.

lines.speaker: Nam (account manager)
lines.text: I will recommend an upgrade in writing today, with a clear cost comparison.

questions.q: Why does Hoa’s system feel slow?
What is included in the business plan?

options: A written upgrade recommendation with costs
